title: Megurine Luka — Happy Anniversary! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hello everyone! Thank you so much for coming to my anniversary show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And hello to everyone watching the stream. Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There are so many people here and watching online, all excited to celebrate your anniversary, Luka!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, there are plenty of comments coming in too!
Like this one: “The quiz you did in your teaser video was so much fun!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really? I'm so glad they enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please look forward to the song from that quiz coming up during the show♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: To express my gratitude for all of you coming to celebrate my anniversary, I'm going to sing with everything I have.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Without further ado, let my anniversary show...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Begin!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The show has only just started, and the energy just now was already out of this world.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course it was! I mean, Luka's singing was also out of this world! Right, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In today's show, there will definitely be more songs that are as exciting as the one just now, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll actually also be singing songs that I haven't performed much.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Really?! Is there a song you'll be performing for the first time?>
<I wasn't sure if Luka was gonna sing my fav since it's hard for shows, but today might be the day!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see that you're all excited.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So many people have let me sing their songs and shared their thoughts and feelings through me over the years.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But since there are more songs than I can count, there are also a lot that I think you all have yet to hear.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which is why I want to sing those songs for you today, so that you get to know them and the different styles of singing I can do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When we heard this from Luka, we were all wondering about what different versions of her will we get to see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. We got really excited thinking about all of the possibilities, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, we really did! I got excited thinking about a screaming rockstar Luka, while Len wanted to see a rapper Luka.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I bet Luka would be so cool rapping!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That reminds me of what side of Luka Rin said she wanted to see. I was surprised.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, yeah, I wanted to see a spooky Luka! She's always so nice and kind, so maybe a spookier version might be an interesting change!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is that so? In that case...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rawr! I'm going to gobble you up!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hahaha, what was that? You're not scary at all! If anything, that was super cute!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, will we get to see all these versions of Luka? We'll find out later in the show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sounds good! Get ready for the second half everybody! Are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Looks like everyone's good to go!
Len, would you do the honors?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: People who have watched the teaser will know this song!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone, let's bring the energy to new heights together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Clap your hands! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow! Luka's managing really high-pitched screams with so much control!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, so much so it sends shivers down your spine! I've never seen her with this kind of aggressive energy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, what? The lights went out! Also, this song is a little creepy...
Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh my gosh! What's going on?! Where is everybody?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Heh heh heh... Peekaboo...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: EEEP!!!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And that is the end of the show. Time sure flies by when you're having fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It sure does. But I had so much fun seeing different versions of Luka and getting to hear so many different songs!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone seems to have really enjoyed themselves too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, now it's time to wrap up with some personal messages from us!
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, Luka!
Getting to see sides of you that I never have before was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It made me happy since I feel like I got to know you better. Let's keep learning more about each other and become even closer friends!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka! Happy anniversary! During the show, you nailed the scary vibes so well that I jumped out of my skin! You wouldn't have thought we'd rehearsed it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I love the responsible and cute sides of you, but getting to see a totally different Luka has just added more things I like about you♪ Hehehe, can't wait to add more and more things to that list!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka! Even though it was for your anniversary, I had so much fun doing a whole bunch of things with you from start to finish!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also, I've got a knack for coming up with fun activities, so let's do a segment again together sometime!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka, you're always radiant, but today you were exuding this new aura that made you shine brighter than ever!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It felt so good to sing together with you and I hope we get to sing lots and lots more with everyone! Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Today's show was non-stop excitement. I couldn't help but get carried away and enjoy it all as if I was in the audience.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Seeing you change things up in order to share your songs and feelings made me realize that I have a lot to learn from you. I hope you have a truly happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Once again, let's all wish all together!
Three, two, one!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I was able to perform songs I don't usually get to and show a different side of myself to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, there are many more songs and feelings that I want to bring to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So I will be continuing to sing for as long as I can. I hope you will all be there to support me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And thank you all for singing with me too.
I had an absolutely lovely anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you again! See you, everyone!
